narrative.overview: Rahma Admin is the morning briefing book of a well-run mobile hijama clinic: every booking's status is named and coloured, every assignment shows the therapist's face, and today's work is legible before the first coffee. The grammar is card-board (the team already uses monday.com and its muscle memory is an asset, not a liability), but the palette, typography, and clinic-specific affordances make it unmistakably Rahma rather than a generic project tool. Warm ivory surfaces, deep clinic green chrome, Cormorant Garamond on marquee numerals, and dignified illustrated empty states define a surface that is calm and scannable at Therapist level, revealing depth for the Owner without becoming cluttered.
keyCharacteristics: Warm ivory surface system: page, card, input — three distinct lightness steps; depth via tonal lift, not shadow
Full status palette: six named families, each with bg tint + text + icon — never colour alone
Cormorant Garamond reserved strictly for marquee numerals on dashboard stat tiles
Staff avatars (real photo or initialled token) on every assignment and staff surface
Dignified illustrated empty states — no dashed borders, no bare 0-items copy
Flat elevation at rest; tonal lift via surface lightness; shadows only in response to interaction
Comfortable density: 16px body base, 24-32px section rhythm, mobile-first throughout

rules.name: The No-Gold-Text Rule
rules.body: Both gold tokens (Rahma Gold and Admin Amber) fail WCAG 3:1 on any ivory surface. Gold is decoration: stat numerals, icon fills, chart colours. Never use as body text, label text, or status text on light backgrounds.

rules.name: The Form Seam Rule
rules.body: Input and interactive component borders use Form Seam (oklch 55%), not Warm Veil. Warm Veil is intentionally decorative and does not meet WCAG 1.4.11 Non-text Contrast.

rules.name: The Named Status Rule
rules.body: A status badge without both a text label and an icon is incomplete and must not ship. Colour-only chips are an absolute ban. The icon supports scanning; the text carries the accessible meaning.

rules.name: The Cormorant Exception
rules.body: Cormorant Garamond appears on numbers and only on numbers — marquee stats and KPI tiles. Body copy, card titles, or form labels in Cormorant is decoration noise. Preserve its rarity.

rules.name: The Tonal Lift Rule
rules.body: A resting card has no shadow. Its elevation comes from being lighter than the page (oklch 99.2% vs 97.8%). Shadows appear only in response to interaction state: hover, overlay open, focus ring.

rules.name: The Green-Tinted Shadow Rule
rules.body: All shadows use the brand green oklch(23% 0.073 155) at low opacity, never rgba(0,0,0,X). This prevents shadows reading as generic and keeps them perceptually warm.

dos: Do vary card composition by content type — BookingListCard is horizontal with avatar + badge; AdminStat is vertical with numeral; ClientCard is avatar-led with rollup stats.
Do include staff avatars (real photo or initialled token, minimum 32px) on every assignment and staff surface.
Do name every status with text label + icon + background tint.
Do reserve Cormorant Garamond for marquee numerals and KPI stats only.
Do keep gender-matching legible as a labelled chip ('Same-gender required') on booking and assignment cards.
Do use dignified illustrated empty states with an SVG illustration, Urbanist heading, and encouraging copy.
Do wrap all form-level error regions in role='alert' aria-live='polite' aria-atomic='true'.
Do mark required form fields with a visible * marker in Cancelled text colour adjacent to every required label.
Do tint all shadows toward the brand green oklch(23% 0.073 155), never rgba(0,0,0,X).
Do use Form Seam (oklch 55%) for input and interactive component borders.
donts: Don't use border-l-4 or any border-left/border-right greater than 1px as a coloured accent on any element. Absolute ban.
Don't use gradient text (background-clip: text combined with gradient fill). Absolute ban.
Don't use Rahma Gold or Admin Amber as body text or label text on any light surface.
Don't use the hero-metric template: large number / small label / supporting stats / gradient accent stacked decoratively.
Don't use identical card grids — same shape with icon + heading + text repeated without variation.
Don't use decorative blobs, glassmorphism, or background blur as a stylistic default.
Don't use purple-and-blue gradients, neon accents, or a dark theme justified by aesthetics.
Don't ship shadcn primitives with default styling — every primitive must be restyled to the Rahma token system.
Don't build a pure-typography admin stripped of avatars and illustration — warmth and visuals are design requirements.
Don't expose raw permission identifiers on access-denied screens — use plain English.
Don't add shadows to panels or cards at rest — shadows are state responses only.
